notFound.title: This branch isn't on the tree
notFound.description: We searched the records but couldn't find what you're looking for. The page may have been moved, deleted, or never existed.

forbidden.title: This page is sealed
forbidden.description: You don't have permission to view this page. Ask the family owner or admin if you think this is a mistake.

unauthorized.title: Sign in to continue
unauthorized.description: This page is behind a closed gate. Sign in to your Ancstra account to continue.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: An unexpected error tipped the inkwell. Try again — and if it keeps happening, share the reference below with support.

offline.title: Lost the connection
offline.description: We couldn't reach Ancstra. Check your network and try again.

personsId.notFoundDescription: This person may have been deleted, or you may not have access to their record.

researchItemId.notFoundDescription: This research item may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
researchItemId.genericDescription: We couldn't load this research item. Try again, or head back to your research list.

researchPersonId.notFoundDescription: This person doesn't have a research record yet, or it may have been removed.

adminFamiliesId.notFoundDescription: This family tree may have been deleted or never existed in the platform records.

adminUsersId.notFoundDescription: This user account may have been deleted or never existed in the platform records.
